In Table 2 (page 1):

- **GeM pooling** uses a **power mean** operation. Its update cost is O(Kd), and it reaches an MAR@100 of 0.447.
- **P-ATT** has an update cost of **O(Kd)**. Its operations are **positional encoding + dot product + softmax + weighted sum**. It has the highest MAR@100 in the table, at 0.450.

All methods in this table aggregate K=10 precomputed 1024-dimensional history embeddings, and none of them need LLM re-inference when the history updates (page 1).
